reserve_count_semantics: Repeated identities in different group reserve lists are not additional independent tasks.
reserve_rule: For a group and stratum, choose the first listed identity not in all original selections, previously used replacements, or preexisting exclusions. Preserve list order and group membership; do not globally sort or deduplicate the lists.
scope: Task identities, purposes, strata, selection seed and ordered reserves only; no task content, source-row hash table, tests, answers, controls or model outputs.
